name: SCVC/VC Separation Class
definition: On the domain $\{x_1,x_2,x_3,z\}$, let $\mathcal C_{\mathrm{SCVC}}=\{0000,1001,1100,1111\}$, where strings list values at $x_1,x_2,x_3,z$ in that order.
comments: A four-concept class witnessing that shattering-cover projection VC dimension can be strictly below VC dimension.
